title: Workspace
description: Thematic collection of channels owned by one user (F4-B Core). Workspaces narrow the existing F4-A allowed_channel_ids scope at the surface layer — service-layer signatures are unchanged.

owner_id.description: FK -> users.id. Cascade-deleted when the user is removed.

name.description: Human label, unique within (owner_id, name) (gotcha § 6). Whitespace-only names are rejected by the service layer and the CHECK constraint.

description.description: Free-form description; not used in scoping logic.

updated_at.description: Last update timestamp; bumped on rename / metadata edits.

WorkspaceSource.description: M2M membership of a channel in a workspace. Composite PK (workspace_id, source_id); the same source_id can be in N workspaces of one owner (Q5 = A).

source_id.description: Matches sources.source_id (VARCHAR — TG channel canonical id).
